item.playerportals.portal_catalyst.toolt: Right-click two frames of void-infused deepslate to link them.
item.playerportals.admin_portal_catalyst: Sneak-right-click a frame to choose the destination, then right-click every frame that should lead there.
playerportals.catalyst.no_frame: No portal frame here. A frame is a closed ring of void-infused deepslate around an empty rectangle, at most 21×21 inside; corners are not needed.
playerportals.catalyst.already_lit: That frame is already a portal.
playerportals.catalyst.attuned: Attuned to a %s. Right-click another frame to link them.
playerportals.catalyst.same_frame: That is the frame the catalyst is attuned to.
playerportals.catalyst.first_gone: The attuned frame has changed. The catalyst is reset.
playerportals.catalyst.crossed: Those frames cross each other, so neither can light.
playerportals.admin.destination_set: Destination set: %s. Right-click every frame that should lead there.
playerportals.admin.no_destination: No destination yet. Sneak-right-click a frame to choose it.
playerportals.admin.linked: One-way portal lit, leading to the %s.
playerportals.admin.already_lit: That frame is already a portal. Break it first to point it elsewhere.
playerportals.admin.no_permission: Only an operator may use the admin catalyst.
playerportals.portal.broken: The other side of this portal is gone.
playerportals.portal.too_small: This portal is too small for you.
playerportals.portal.cannot_travel: This portal cannot take you there.
playerportals.break.no_permission: You may not break a portal.
